parameters.name: DestinationCidrBlock
parameters.description: The destination CIDR block of the route entry in the gateway route table to query.

parameters.name: GatewayRouteTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the gateway route table to query.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token. Valid values:
- If this is the first query or no subsequent query exists, leave this parameter empty.
- If a subsequent query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the gateway route table that you want to query.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
